basic_info.description: Prime investment opportunity in the heart of San Francisco's Inner Sunset! This fully occupied six-unit apartment building at 1277 9th Ave features four 2BD/1BA units and two studio units, plus seven parking spacesa rare urban find. Recent updates include a fresh exterior paint job, new windows, and a new water heater. With strong rental demand and great upside potential, this property is ideally situated in close proximity to Inner Sunset shops and dining, Golden Gate Park, and renowned institutions such as UCSF and USF. Access to Muni and major transit routes ensures excellent connectivity, making this an exceptional addition to any investment portfolio.
